relations.title: When You Have to Decide Before You Can Discover
The Minimal Information a Transformation Needs
Coste total de una intervención
relations.reading: A transformation business case should include the costs of looking, making binding declarations and absorbing their consequences, not only implementation expenditure.

relations.title: Reparación acotada
relations.reading: Upstream work should produce a focusable mission and explicit residual uncertainty before execution is compressed, with the cost of that preparation visible.

relations.reading: Focus ON can distinguish an observable operating obstacle from a still-unmade declaration of ownership, scope or priority that the diagnosis cannot simply discover.
